note.value: This Crystal was originally empowered to provide a warding spell over its owner, however its original owner Caltahari died when his ship crashed on the shore of Ulthuan. When its powers are invoked his ghostly ship, the Pride of Caltahar, rises from the depths in front of his enemy.

The Damned Sphere is used at the start of the Magic phase, before any spells are cast. Any Chaos sorcerer who has cast a spell must make a 3 dice roll or have their spells cast reduced. On a 3-6 the Admiral adds +1 to these rolls.
